svg.font-family: pw-sans-rxndfomfee, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Parcelpoint services on a laptop
svg.desc: Parcelpoint services on a laptop: 6 nodes, 6 connections. The 5 services of a Docker Compose file in 2 networks, with 1 named volume. Each arrow points from a service to one it depends on. Nodes: - tracking-data (Named volume), storage - Virtual network: edge - web (build ./web, port 3000), service - api (ghcr.io/parcelpoint/tracking-api:1.8.2, port 8080), service - Virtual network: data - worker (ghcr.io/parcelpoint/event-worker:1.8.2), service - db (postgres:16-alpine), database - queue (rabbitmq:3.13-management), queue Connections: - web to api - api to db - api to queue - worker to db - worker to queue - db to tracking-data (stored data line): mounts
